// CASE ts_worker_regex_literal_swallow_dup expect=fire
export async function a<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<string>) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      merge((await operation(items[index])).replace(/'/g, ""), await operation(items[index]), "'");
    }
  }));
}
// CASE ts_inorder_regex_literal_single expect=pass
export async function inOrder<T>(items: T[], step: (item: T) => Promise<void>, { reason }: { reason: string }) {
  void reason;
  for (const item of items) {
    log(await step(item), /it's/);
  }
}
